purpose: Choose a baryon-only geometric activation field before opening any P0633 galaxy kinematics or P0640 raw-lensing constraints.
candidate_field_equation: laplacian(Phi)=div[(nu(|g_N|/a0) I + lambda S(|g_N|/a0) C_b h_hat h_hat) grad(Phi_N)]

definitions.g_N: minus grad(Phi_N), computed only from the registered baryonic surface-density map
definitions.S: a0/(a0+|g_N|), so the geometric channel vanishes in high acceleration
definitions.ell: beta |g_N| / ||H(Phi_N)||_F, clipped only for numerical domain support
definitions.path_incoherence: 1 minus the squared magnitude of the mean unit Newtonian-field direction traced for ell along its own field line
definitions.h_hat: normalized mean direction along the same baryon-only field-line trace
definitions.lambda: one non-negative universal geometric strength; it is not fitted in P0642

selection_rule: Advance the simplest variant that passes its applicable synthetic gates and shows the largest median cluster-to-galaxy activation ratio. Do not use any P0633/P0640 target outcome, lens residual, image family, velocity, or inferred dark-matter map in selection.
claim_boundary: P0642 tests whether the geometry variable is measurable, invariant, screened, and domain-selective; it does not test whether the law fits rotation curves or lensing.
The thin-sheet calculation is a projected diagnostic of a dimension-independent field equation, not a relativistic completion.
A favorable cluster-to-galaxy separation can arise from map morphology alone and is not evidence that gravity physically travels along the traced paths.
lambda remains unselected until a spent-data ablation is run and must then be frozen before P0633/P0640 unsealing.
